description: This file defines the CordzInfo class, which tracks profiling information for Cord objects in the Abseil library. It includes methods for tracking, untracking, and managing Cord profiling data, as well as internal data structures and synchronization mechanisms.

classes.name: CordzInfo
classes.description: Tracks profiling and diagnostic information for a Cord object, including methods for managing its lifecycle, synchronization, and profiling data.

methods.name: TrackCord
methods.description: Creates a CordzInfo instance to track metrics of a sampled Cord, and stores it in the global list.

methods.name: TrackCord (overload)
methods.description: Creates a CordzInfo instance for a Cord based on a source Cord, used for copy construction or assignment.

methods.name: MaybeTrackCord
methods.description: Randomly profiles a Cord for sampling based on a profiling decision.

methods.name: MaybeTrackCord (overload)
methods.description: Profiles a Cord based on a source Cord, with logic to prevent cycles.

methods.name: Untrack
methods.description: Stops tracking a Cord and cleans up associated profiling info.

methods.name: MaybeUntrackCord
methods.description: Safely untracks a CordzInfo if it is not null.

methods.name: Head
methods.description: Returns the oldest existing CordzInfo in a snapshot.

methods.name: Next
methods.description: Returns the next older CordzInfo in the list.

methods.name: SetCordRep
methods.description: Updates the Cord representation associated with this profiling info.

methods.name: RefCordRep
methods.description: Returns a reference to the current Cord representation, with thread safety.

methods.name: GetCordzStatistics
methods.description: Retrieves profiling statistics for the Cord.

methods.name: GetStack
methods.description: Returns the stack trace where the Cord was first sampled.

methods.name: GetParentStack
methods.description: Returns the parent stack trace for the sampled Cord.
